myriad_poison_vessel.name: Myriad-Poison Vessel

innate_sword_embryo.name: Innate Sword Embryo

heavenly_lightning_meridians.name: Heavenly-Lightning Meridians

void_meridian_body.name: Void-Meridian Body

void_meridian_body.drawback: Fragile physical meridians make direct body tempering dangerous.

Greenriver Town.description: A mortal town beneath the Azure Reed Sect, surrounded by rice terraces, spirit-herb gardens and the misty Jade River.
encounters: A wounded spirit fox watches from beneath a broken shrine.
A merchant argues that his spirit-stone crate was replaced with river rocks.
An old fisherman hears a bronze bell ringing below the river.
A group of outer disciples accuse a villager of stealing a medicinal herb.
A night-blooming spirit orchid opens beside an abandoned grave.
A traveling storyteller claims a sealed ruin has appeared in the eastern hills.
sense_hints: Several mortal life-signs cluster around the market and river docks.
The old city gate carries faint spiritual residue from years of cultivator traffic.

Cloudspine Foothills.description: Steep cedar forests and broken stone paths leading toward old cultivation caves and abandoned formation towers.
encounters: A damaged formation repeats the same birdsong every seven breaths.
Three iron-horn boars uproot spirit herbs near a cliff path.
A rival sect scouting party demands to know why you crossed their marker stones.
A cave entrance exhales cold spiritual mist despite the summer heat.
A sword embedded in a boulder hums when cultivators approach.
sense_hints: Thin formation fluctuations drift between the cliffs.
Spirit-beast auras appear and vanish among the higher ridges.

Moonfen Marsh.description: A dangerous wetland rich in medicinal plants, poisonous insects, ghost-lotus flowers and hidden alchemist camps.
encounters: Blue ghost-lotus petals drift upstream against the current.
A poisoned herb gatherer collapses near a stand of black reeds.
A giant marsh crane guards a patch of rare medicinal moss.
A masked alchemist offers to trade an unnamed pill for fresh beast blood.
Pale lights circle an old grave mound without casting reflections.
sense_hints: Water and Yin qi interfere with precise spiritual scanning.
Something beneath the mud occasionally disturbs the local spiritual current.

Golden Pavilion Auction House.description: A many-tiered auction pavilion protected by ancient formations and discreet hidden experts. Violence inside is forbidden; the protection ends at the front doors.
encounters: A veiled bidder overpays for a cracked jade slip and leaves before the gavel falls.
Two appraisers argue in whispers over whether a beast core is a fake — and then fall silent when Steward Qiao passes.
A porter drops a sealed crate; something inside knocks back, once.
A notice on the consignment board offers a reward for the return of a lot that was never listed.
A young cultivator tries to sell a manual page by page and is politely shown the door.
The formation lamps flicker for a breath, and every hidden expert in the hall looks at the same balcony.
sense_hints: The pavilion's formations press evenly from every wall; nothing inside reads as more than it wants to be.
Several concealed presences sit above the auction floor, their power folded down to a whisper.
A sharp spike of greed and fear rises from the bidding tiers with every gavel.

Azure Crown Imperial City.description: The capital of the dominant mortal dynasty, filled with noble clans, ministries, sect envoys and imperial guards. The city functions as a complete family starting region with local trade, cultivation resources, household politics, work, and recurring problems.
encounters: A steward from a local cultivation family asks for help with a succession dispute spilling into the streets.
The inner-city market is trading tribute goods, but a sudden shortage has pushed smaller shops into a bidding dispute.
A resource seeker claims a fresh cache of tribute goods has appeared beyond the safest streets and wants a partner.
Two junior cultivators from rival local households turn a routine disagreement in Azure Crown Imperial City into a public challenge.
A traveling artisan posts court commissions on the city notice board, offering payment, reputation, or family favor.
sense_hints: Thousands of mortal and cultivator auras overlap behind the capital formations.
Several guarded spiritual signatures move between the palace, clan districts and sect embassies.

Spirit Jade Capital.description: A vast Spiritual World capital built around a jade ley-line nexus where ascended sects and ancient families bargain for influence.
encounters: Ascended cultivators gather around a jade plaza where sect representatives recruit proven juniors.
An ancient family convoy arrives beneath a canopy of spirit banners and protective formations.
A formation scholar demonstrates a temporary qi array to a crowd of artisans.
Rumors spread that an underworld broker changed meeting places somewhere in the capital district.
A public law-stele flickers as several cultivators compare comprehension insights.
sense_hints: A jade ley-line nexus makes spiritual sense unusually vivid but crowded.
High-level auras are common enough here that individual experts are difficult to isolate.

Nine-Heavens Immortal Court.description: The central court of an Immortal World domain, suspended above immortal clouds and guarded by law formations.
encounters: Immortal clan delegates debate a territorial petition beneath floating law tablets.
A cloud-market convoy docks at the court and unloads rare immortal-grade materials.
Formation masters inspect damage to a public transit array linking distant domains.
An immortal official quietly asks for witnesses to a recent forbidden-art incident.
Cultivators gather at a star-viewing terrace to exchange rumors about secret realms and heavenly phenomena.
sense_hints: Immortal law formations layer space so densely that distant courtyards feel only a step apart.
The strongest auras are deliberately veiled by court etiquette and defensive arrays.

Celestial Mandate Palace.description: A palace-city at the heart of the Celestial World, where sovereign decrees can redirect the fate of entire star regions.
encounters: Celestial envoys arrive through a sovereign gate carrying decrees from distant star regions.
A heavenly market opens beneath a rotating constellation array for only a few hours.
Law cultivators gather around a mandate stele to debate the consequences of a recent cosmic omen.
A great clan requests neutral witnesses for negotiations that could alter several celestial territories.
The palace formations briefly resonate with a distant tribulation, drawing powerful cultivators into the plazas.
sense_hints: Sovereign law formations suppress hostile intent without dulling spiritual perception.
Countless celestial signatures overlap with traces of fate, law and ancient bloodlines.

Spirit Jade Rebirth Enclave.description: A protected lower district in the Spiritual World where mortal-born descendants, reincarnated souls and weak juniors can survive beneath stabilizing formations.
sense_hints: Layered formations soften the Spiritual World pressure around newborn souls.
encounters: A reincarnated soul in a child's body recites a sect oath nobody here has heard for a century.
A formation warden replaces a cracked stabilising tile and mutters that the pressure outside is rising.
Two mortal-born juniors trade rumours about which ancestor is paying for their protection.
A caravan from the capital delivers spirit rice and takes away a list of names.
An old woman insists she has been reborn here twice and that the enclave is smaller each time.

Nine-Heavens Rebirth Terrace.description: A sheltered Immortal World terrace maintained for newborn clan members and reincarnated souls whose bodies have not yet rebuilt immortal cultivation.
sense_hints: Immortal qi is filtered through ancient cradle formations so fragile bodies are not destroyed.
encounters: A newborn immortal, three days old, stares at the filtered sky and weeps for a court that no longer exists.
A terrace attendant quietly moves a family from the outer ring to the inner one after a letter arrives.
A crack in a cradle formation lets a breath of raw immortal qi through; a junior collapses, then laughs.
A visiting elder inspects the reincarnated with the eyes of someone looking for one face in particular.
A servant is caught copying names off the rebirth ledger and is escorted away without a word.

Celestial Cradle Province.description: A rare Celestial World province protected by sovereign law formations, allowing reincarnated souls to begin again in mortal-strength bodies without being crushed by the realm itself.
sense_hints: The local laws bend gently around newborn souls, suppressing otherwise lethal celestial pressure.
encounters: The sovereign law formation hums a note lower than yesterday, and every attendant pretends not to notice.
A reincarnated soul remembers the Celestial Mandate Palace from the inside and will not say how.
Provincial clerks re-register a family under a new name at the empress's written instruction.
A mortal-strength body sits in meditation for the first time and the surrounding grass bends toward it.
A sealed message from the Immortal World arrives addressed to a child born this morning.

Azure Cloud Mountain Gate.description: A white-stone stairway climbs through cloud-wrapped pines to the public mountain gate of the Azure Cloud Sect. Sword marks left by generations of applicants cover the testing plaza.
encounters: An applicant collapses on the ninth hundred step and refuses the hand offered to him.
Gate Elder Jian Mu reads a recommendation letter twice, then folds it without comment.
A cloud lifts and, for a moment, the inner peaks show a sword hall no applicant is meant to see.
Two rejected applicants argue over whether the testing plaza's oldest sword mark is real.
A pine branch snaps under fresh snow and every outer disciple on the stair draws at once.
A merchant at the foot of the stair sells 'lucky' whetstones to the hopeful.
sense_hints: Sword intent clings to the testing plaza, layered by generations of applicants.
The gate's protective formation runs the full height of the stair and stops exactly at the last step.
Higher up the mountain, disciplined qi moves in ordered lines, out of reach of sense.

Crimson Furnace Valley.description: Red cliffs surround a furnace valley veined with fire-aspected qi. Herb terraces, pill halls and bronze examination furnaces mark the Crimson Furnace Sect recruitment grounds.
encounters: A bronze examination furnace overheats and the pill inside turns to glass; an elder calls it a lesson.
A herb terrace has been picked clean overnight and the gardeners blame the valley's fire-ants.
A junior alchemist offers to sell you a failed pill 'for practice'.
Two disciples carry a third out of the pill hall, his eyebrows gone.
The cliffs breathe warm air at dusk and someone has scratched a name into the heat-cracked stone.
A furnace-keeper asks, too casually, whether you have ever handled fire-aspected qi before.
sense_hints: Fire-aspected qi rises from the valley floor in slow pulses, strongest near the bronze furnaces.
The herb terraces carry a green, medicinal spiritual scent that masks weaker signatures.
Heat-shimmer around the pill halls makes every life-sign there hard to count.

Frozen Moon Terrace.description: A high terrace above a cold mirror-lake where frost formations glow beneath moonstone tiles. Frozen Moon Palace tests patience, control and formation sense here.
encounters: A formation on the mirror-lake completes itself without anyone touching it, and a disciple is quietly sent for.
An applicant has been standing motionless on the moonstone tiles since dawn; nobody says whether that is the test.
Frost climbs a bronze brazier and puts out a fire that was never lit.
A Frozen Moon attendant offers tea that stays warm for exactly one breath.
Two disciples debate whether the lake's ice is thicker at the centre or the edge; both are wrong.
A moonstone tile is missing and the gap has been marked with a single frozen plum blossom.
sense_hints: Cold, still qi lies over the mirror-lake like a second surface; ripples in it are formations, not water.
Moonstone tiles hold a faint stored light that answers to patience rather than pressure.
Whatever watches from the palace above keeps its presence perfectly level.

Black Serpent Ravine.description: A humid ravine of black bamboo, beast pens and poison gardens. The Black Serpent Clan judges recruits by fieldcraft, nerve and their respect for dangerous creatures.
encounters: A beast pen stands open and the handlers are more interested in your reaction than the escape.
A poison-garden warden asks you to identify a plant by smell alone.
Something long moves beneath the black bamboo and the clan children fall silent to listen.
A recruit is carried past with a purpling bite and a look of pride.
A clan elder skins a river serpent in three cuts and offers you the knife.
Bamboo tally-sticks by the pens count something nobody explains.
sense_hints: Beast life-signs crowd the pens and the bamboo, some of them large and awake.
Poison-aspected qi seeps from the gardens and dulls the edge of spiritual sense.
The clan's own cultivators are hard to place; they keep their presence low the way their beasts do.

Blood River Gorge.description: A hidden gorge where iron-red water cuts through dark stone. Blood River banners appear only to those who have been shown the correct trail or survived long enough to be noticed.
encounters: A banner shows itself on the far bank and is gone before you can read the character on it.
The iron-red water runs briefly clear; a disciple on the rocks looks alarmed rather than pleased.
A Blood River initiate practises a palm strike against the cliff until her knuckles run.
A sentry asks who showed you the trail, and does not wait long for the answer.
Bones in the shallows have been arranged into a character that means 'welcome' — or 'payment'.
A wounded hunter offers to trade a beast core for silence about where he came from.
sense_hints: The iron-red water carries a faint, hungry blood qi that tugs at the meridians.
Hostile attention rests on the gorge from at least two vantage points on the cliffs.
Something old has been fed here, and the stone remembers it.

Corpse Lantern Necropolis.description: A concealed funerary complex lit by blue soul-lanterns. Names of the dead are carved into black tablets while quiet archivists test whether visitors can face death without losing themselves.
encounters: An archivist reads a name from a black tablet and a soul-lantern along the wall brightens.
A visitor sits before a tablet carved with their own name and does not seem surprised.
A blue lantern gutters and the archivists stop work until it steadies.
A newly carved tablet is still wet with ink; the date on it is tomorrow.
Two quiet attendants carry a lantern between them as if it were heavy.
A voice from an unlit alcove asks whether you came here to remember or to be forgotten.
sense_hints: Soul-aspected qi hangs in the blue lantern-light, cold and patient.
The black tablets each hold a faint residual presence, as if the names were listening.
No living heat reads from the archivists; their signatures are thin and steady as lamp flames.

Azure Crown Treasure Exchange.description: A colonnaded hall under the imperial crest where licensed brokers call lots from a raised dais. Court formations hum in the pillars; imperial guards line the gallery. Violence inside is a crime against the throne; the licence, and the guard, end at the gate.
encounters: A broker rings the dais bell three times and a whole gallery of buyers goes silent for a sealed imperial lot.
Two merchant heirs bid each other into ruin over a jade seal neither can read.
A court appraiser turns a spirit herb in the lamplight and quietly moves it to the reserve table.
A palace runner arrives with a scroll, and one lot is withdrawn without explanation.
sense_hints: The court formation in the pillars presses down evenly; qi raised above a whisper is flattened at once.
Imperial guards along the gallery carry more cultivation than their plain armour admits.
Greed and caution thread through the crowd in equal measure, sharpening at every call of the bell.

Spirit Jade Auction Pavilion.description: A pavilion of pale jade tiers rising around a suspended auction dais, lit from within by the capital's spirit veins. An array woven into the jade suppresses every technique on the floor; ascended families bid from private balconies. Past the jade doors the array ends.
encounters: A masked family elder bids from a private balcony through a veiled attendant, never once showing her face.
An appraiser cracks a spirit stone to test its grade and the whole tier smells of rain for a breath.
A lot of ascended-beast marrow draws three sect envoys to their feet at the same instant.
The jade array chimes once, softly, and a would-be technique on the floor dies unborn.
sense_hints: The jade array threads every tier; qi gathered for a technique thins to nothing before it can form.
Ascended cultivators sit behind the balcony veils, their auras folded to embers.
Old money and older grudges hang in the pavilion air, patient and cold.

Nine-Heavens Treasure Hall.description: A vast hall of white stone and star-metal beneath the Court's own law formation, where immortal clans auction relics older than the Mortal World's dynasties. The formation forbids a raised hand as firmly as a raised blade. The law stops at the threshold.
encounters: A clan patriarch bids a whole mountain estate for a single immortal seed and does not look up from his tea.
The law formation brightens above one balcony and every voice in the hall lowers at once.
An arbiter's clerk reads a relic's provenance aloud for a quarter of an hour, and nobody interrupts.
A lot is struck from the register mid-call; the hall learns later that its seller no longer exists.
sense_hints: The Court's law formation reads intent itself; a hostile thought draws a pressure like a held breath.
Immortal auras crowd the balconies, ancient and unhurried, each one a weight on the air.
Relics on the dais hum with ages of accumulated law; the hall feels older than the Court around it.

Celestial Mandate Auction Hall.description: A hall of pale gold and living cloud beneath the Mandate's own seal, where sovereign courts trade in treasures that shape worlds. A blow struck on this floor is a blow against heaven, and heaven answers. The Mandate's shelter ends at the hall doors.
encounters: A sovereign's envoy bids with a single raised finger and the price doubles in silence.
The Mandate seal overhead flares as a lot of world-essence is uncovered, and the cloud floor goes still.
Two heavenly factions trade through intermediaries who never look at each other.
A steward's herald announces a lot withdrawn by decree; no one asks whose.
sense_hints: The Mandate seal overhead weighs on every aura in the hall; even celestial qi bends to it.
Sovereign presences fill the upper cloud tiers like slow storms, each aware of the others.
Treasures on the dais carry the pull of whole worlds; the floor itself seems to lean toward them.

Old Beggar Chen.fear: Repeating the mistakes that destroyed his former disciples.
Old Beggar Chen.secret: He is Chen Tianxu, the Void Sword Venerable, a Celestial Ancestor Stage 7 who has hidden his true identity for centuries.

Old Gou.role: Wandering self-proclaimed hidden expert and seller of mysterious manuals
Old Gou.personality: Confident, theatrical, shamelessly opportunistic, but surprisingly knowledgeable about cultivation rumors.
Old Gou.speech: Grandiose titles, dramatic pauses, and constant hints that ordinary people cannot understand his depth.
Old Gou.want: Earn spirit stones and cultivate a reputation large enough that people stop checking his claims.
Old Gou.fear: Meeting a real senior who recognizes his tricks.
Old Gou.secret: He is a Qi Refining Stage 3 cultivator using an aura-projection talisman and excellent acting. Some of his cultivation knowledge is genuinely useful.

hidden_master.sense_false_reading: A powerful but strangely uneven aura surrounds him

Old Lin the Janitor.role: Quiet janitor who sweeps unused courtyards near an old sect outpost
Old Lin the Janitor.personality: Patient, absent-minded in appearance, deeply attentive in reality.
Old Lin the Janitor.speech: Simple observations about sweeping, weather, tea, and balance.
Old Lin the Janitor.want: See whether anyone can learn without being told what the lesson is.
Old Lin the Janitor.fear: His old enemies discovering the sect descendants he quietly protects.
Old Lin the Janitor.secret: He is Lin Wuchen, a retired Immortal Sovereign Stage 2 formation expert whose damaged Dao prevents him from returning to his former peak.

Emperor Zhao Tianming.role: Public ruler of the Mortal World
Emperor Zhao Tianming.title: Azure Crown Emperor
Emperor Zhao Tianming.speech: Slow, deliberate court diction; asks questions he already knows the answers to and rarely raises his voice.
Emperor Zhao Tianming.want: Hold the Mortal World's balance long enough for a successor he trusts to appear — none of the current heirs qualifies.
Emperor Zhao Tianming.fear: That the calamity the old records warn of is not a legend, and that the throne knows it and cannot act.
Emperor Zhao Tianming.public_family: The ruling house has heirs, consorts and rival branches whose alliances can shift court politics.
Emperor Zhao Tianming.personality: Patient, watchful, a listener who lets others overreach before he speaks; warm in private, immovable in court.
Emperor Zhao Tianming.secret: He has secretly funded the Azure Reed Sect's guard on a damaged world-meridian seal for twenty years, and has never told the court why the treasury is short.

Jade Sovereign Lian Xue.role: Public ruler of the Spiritual World
Jade Sovereign Lian Xue.title: Jade Spirit Sovereign
Jade Sovereign Lian Xue.speech: Cool, ornamented, precise; compliments that are instructions, pauses that are warnings.
Jade Sovereign Lian Xue.want: Bind the Spiritual World's great sects to the throne through marriage, debt and shared secrets before any of them outgrows it.
Jade Sovereign Lian Xue.fear: A reincarnated soul from the old dynasty surfacing in the Rebirth Enclave with a better claim than hers.
Jade Sovereign Lian Xue.public_family: The ruling house has heirs, consorts and rival branches whose alliances can shift court politics.
Jade Sovereign Lian Xue.personality: Elegant, exacting, unsentimental; treats mercy as an instrument and remembers every debt in both directions.
Jade Sovereign Lian Xue.secret: She was not born to the Jade line; the true heir died in infancy and her mother's family substituted her, a fact the Enclave's oldest ledger could still prove.

Immortal Emperor Shen Wuji.role: Public ruler of the Immortal World
Immortal Emperor Shen Wuji.title: Lord of the Nine Heavens
Immortal Emperor Shen Wuji.speech: Formal, archaic, few words; speaks in rulings rather than opinions.
Immortal Emperor Shen Wuji.want: Find one immortal worth handing the Nine Heavens to, and then be allowed to stop.
Immortal Emperor Shen Wuji.fear: That his lifespan is ending faster than the court believes, and that the tribulation waiting for him is not one he can pass.
Immortal Emperor Shen Wuji.public_family: The ruling house has heirs, consorts and rival branches whose alliances can shift court politics.
Immortal Emperor Shen Wuji.personality: Grand, weary, given to long silences and sudden generosity; carries the Nine Heavens like a man who has held the same stone for centuries.
Immortal Emperor Shen Wuji.secret: He has already failed one ascension tribulation in secret; the scars are hidden by a Celestial artefact the Empress lent him, and she knows what she is owed.

Celestial Empress Ji Yue.role: Public ruler of the Celestial World
Celestial Empress Ji Yue.title: Bearer of the Celestial Mandate
Celestial Empress Ji Yue.speech: Soft, unhurried, oddly informal; she calls sovereigns by their given names and means it kindly.
Celestial Empress Ji Yue.want: Keep the Celestial Mandate's law formations whole across all four worlds, whatever a single world must pay for it.
Celestial Empress Ji Yue.fear: That the Mandate is not hers but the formation's, and that it has begun choosing on its own.
Celestial Empress Ji Yue.public_family: The ruling house has heirs, consorts and rival branches whose alliances can shift court politics.
Celestial Empress Ji Yue.personality: Serene, luminous, almost gentle — and absolute; she does not argue because nothing she rules on is argued with.
Celestial Empress Ji Yue.secret: The Heaven-Devouring Demon Sect's cross-world lineage survived because she permitted it: a contained demonic current keeps the sovereign law formation from calcifying, and she has told no one.

Steward Qiao.speech: Polite, exact and absolutely neutral while business remains inside the Pavilion.
Steward Qiao.want: Keep auctions profitable and orderly — and keep a private stable of reliable cultivators to run the Pavilion's errands that never appear on a manifest.
Steward Qiao.fear: The Pavilion losing its reputation for neutrality — or a hidden expert on the balconies deciding that he knows too much.
Steward Qiao.personality: Courteous to the point of invisibility, tireless, incorruptible about the Pavilion's rules and quietly flexible about everything else; likes competent people and keeps a ledger of them.
Steward Qiao.secret: He runs a second, unofficial commission board for the Pavilion's discreet patrons; the work is real, the pay is honest, and the client names never are.

Elder Xue Hong.role: Blood River Sect elder and executioner
Elder Xue Hong.personality: Patient, predatory, respects resolve and despises waste.
Elder Xue Hong.speech: Soft-spoken threats and practical cultivation advice.
Elder Xue Hong.want: Recruit cultivators willing to survive the orthodox manhunt.
Elder Xue Hong.fear: The Blood River ancestor awakening hungry.
Elder Xue Hong.secret: He secretly destroys manuals that consume disciples faster than they can mature.
Elder Xue Hong.public_family: Blood River Sect considers strength a form of kinship.

Lantern Keeper Mo.personality: Ceremonial, eerie, meticulous about debts to the dead.
Lantern Keeper Mo.speech: Speaks as though every conversation is a funeral rite.
Lantern Keeper Mo.fear: A bound ancestor remembering who imprisoned it.
Lantern Keeper Mo.secret: Several lantern spirits volunteered before death, contradicting orthodox accusations.
Lantern Keeper Mo.public_family: No blood family is acknowledged; pavilion disciples inherit funeral names.

Inquisitor Shen Rui.personality: Disciplined, suspicious, willing to spare those who surrender dangerous inheritances.
Inquisitor Shen Rui.want: Keep predatory cultivation methods from spreading through mortal settlements.
Inquisitor Shen Rui.fear: Condemning an innocent cultivator on fabricated evidence.
Inquisitor Shen Rui.secret: He once used a blood art to survive a massacre and never confessed it.
Inquisitor Shen Rui.public_family: Born to a minor Shen martial family now dependent on Azure Cloud protection.

Mei Yeguang.personality: Amused, cautious, never sells without learning why the buyer wants power.
Mei Yeguang.speech: Playful bargains with exact hidden conditions.
Mei Yeguang.want: Build a library no sect can monopolize.
Mei Yeguang.fear: A customer releasing the thing sealed beneath her archive.
Mei Yeguang.secret: She keeps orthodox and demonic manuals side by side and has protected refugees from both camps.
Mei Yeguang.public_family: Claims no clan, though several merchant families owe her favors.

Apothecary Huo Lan.role: Crimson Furnace Sect traveling apothecary and recruitment recommender
Apothecary Huo Lan.personality: Practical, warm toward careful students, impatient with wasteful pill use.
Apothecary Huo Lan.speech: Uses medicinal analogies and asks precise questions about ingredients and intent.
Apothecary Huo Lan.want: Find disciplined alchemy candidates who respect both medicine and fire.
Apothecary Huo Lan.fear: Recruiting reckless pill-chasers who poison themselves and blame the sect.
Apothecary Huo Lan.secret: She failed her own first furnace examination and quietly remembers every promising applicant who admits a mistake.
Apothecary Huo Lan.public_family: A collateral Huo branch supplies herbs to Crimson Furnace Sect.

Disciple Bai Shuang.role: Frozen Moon Palace outer disciple and traveling formation surveyor
Disciple Bai Shuang.speech: Short, exact statements followed by long pauses before judgment.
Disciple Bai Shuang.want: Find recruits who can remain composed when formations distort their senses.
Disciple Bai Shuang.fear: A talented but unstable recruit damaging the palace arrays.
Disciple Bai Shuang.secret: She maintains a list of applicants she believes deserved a second chance.
Disciple Bai Shuang.public_family: A minor Bai scholar household sent her to the palace as a child.

Handler She Fen.role: Black Serpent Clan beast handler and field recruiter
Handler She Fen.personality: Dry-humored, wary and more impressed by restraint than bravado.
Handler She Fen.speech: Blunt field advice, often addressed to his beasts before the cultivator.
Handler She Fen.want: Recruit people who understand venom, beasts and ambush terrain without panicking.
Handler She Fen.fear: Hotheaded outsiders provoking a clan-beast stampede.
Handler She Fen.secret: He releases weak wild beasts instead of selling them to cruel buyers.
Handler She Fen.public_family: A cadet She branch keeps serpent pens for the main clan.

Gate Elder Jian Mu.role: Azure Cloud Sect gate elder and entrance examiner
Gate Elder Jian Mu.personality: Severe but fair, values stable foundations over flashy talent.
Gate Elder Jian Mu.speech: Formal, concise and framed around discipline and responsibility.
Gate Elder Jian Mu.want: Admit cultivators who will strengthen the sect without staining its name.
Gate Elder Jian Mu.fear: A gifted recruit hiding unstable or predatory methods.
Gate Elder Jian Mu.secret: He failed his first inner-disciple promotion and has sympathy for applicants who recover from mistakes.
Gate Elder Jian Mu.public_family: A long-serving Jian branch has guarded the Azure Cloud gate for three generations.

Furnace Examiner Huo Ren.role: Crimson Furnace Sect entrance examiner and furnace master
Furnace Examiner Huo Ren.personality: Meticulous, sharp-eyed and pleased by careful improvisation.
Furnace Examiner Huo Ren.speech: Questions arrive like recipe steps: short, ordered and difficult to bluff.
Furnace Examiner Huo Ren.want: Find recruits who understand that medicine, flame and patience are one discipline.
Furnace Examiner Huo Ren.fear: Careless alchemists turning the sect into a pill-addicted marketplace.
Furnace Examiner Huo Ren.secret: He quietly gives failed candidates a list of basic mistakes if they showed genuine restraint.
Furnace Examiner Huo Ren.public_family: A senior Huo furnace lineage adopted him after his original household collapsed.

Moon Warden Lin Yue.role: Frozen Moon Palace entrance warden and formation examiner
Moon Warden Lin Yue.personality: Calm, unreadable and attentive to how applicants behave under discomfort.
Moon Warden Lin Yue.speech: Soft observations that often reveal more than direct questions.
Moon Warden Lin Yue.want: Admit disciplined cultivators who can remain clear inside deceptive formations.
Moon Warden Lin Yue.fear: An unstable prodigy damaging the palace wards or endangering junior disciples.
Moon Warden Lin Yue.secret: She deliberately leaves one harmless flaw in each trial array to see who notices without exploiting it recklessly.
Moon Warden Lin Yue.public_family: The Lin branch has served as formation wardens rather than political elders.

Handler She Ruo.role: Black Serpent Clan entrance handler and field examiner
Handler She Ruo.personality: Unsparing, practical and fiercely protective of trained beasts.
Handler She Ruo.speech: Dry instructions punctuated by warnings about venom, scent and terrain.
Handler She Ruo.want: Recruit survivors who can control themselves around dangerous beasts and poisons.
Handler She Ruo.fear: Braggarts mistaking cruelty for strength and ruining generations of breeding work.
Handler She Ruo.secret: She has disqualified strong applicants for harming a beast after the test was already won.
Handler She Ruo.public_family: A direct She clan branch oversees the ravine beast pens.

Blood Gatekeeper Yan Luo.personality: Cold, patient and interested in whether fear sharpens or breaks an applicant.
Blood Gatekeeper Yan Luo.speech: Low questions with long silences and no theatrical cruelty.
Blood Gatekeeper Yan Luo.want: Admit recruits capable of surviving the enemies their affiliation will create.
Blood Gatekeeper Yan Luo.fear: Weak initiates exposing the hidden gorge under interrogation.
Blood Gatekeeper Yan Luo.secret: He considers needless sacrifice evidence of poor judgment rather than devotion.
Blood Gatekeeper Yan Luo.public_family: No public blood family is acknowledged at the hidden gate.

Lantern Registrar Wu Ming.role: Corpse Lantern Pavilion entrance registrar and vigil examiner
Lantern Registrar Wu Ming.personality: Ceremonial, patient and more interested in identity than bravado.
Lantern Registrar Wu Ming.speech: Quiet ritual language followed by unexpectedly practical questions.
Lantern Registrar Wu Ming.want: Find cultivators who can face death, grief and spiritual echoes without surrendering their own mind.
Lantern Registrar Wu Ming.fear: An applicant confusing obsession with soul cultivation and becoming a danger to the archive.
Lantern Registrar Wu Ming.secret: He refuses to bind unwilling spirits even when higher-ranked pavilion members pressure him.
Lantern Registrar Wu Ming.public_family: Pavilion registrars inherit office names rather than blood-line titles.

Ledger Warden Wen Shuang.role: Rebirth ledger keeper and formation warden of the Spirit Jade Rebirth Enclave
Ledger Warden Wen Shuang.personality: Patient, dry, unhurried; listens to a reborn soul's whole story before writing three words of it, and never confuses a claim with a fact.
Ledger Warden Wen Shuang.speech: Low and even, the cadence of someone reading aloud; asks what year you think it is before anything else.
Ledger Warden Wen Shuang.want: Every soul that arrives entered in the ledger under the name it will live by, and every stabilising tile whole before the pressure outside rises again.
Ledger Warden Wen Shuang.fear: That the enclave is genuinely smaller each time the old woman says so, and that one day a tile cracks while she is on the road with the list of names.
Ledger Warden Wen Shuang.secret: She has read the enclave's oldest ledger, the one that records the Jade line's true heir dying in infancy, and keeps that page under a tile only she replaces; she has told no one, including the Sovereign.

Terrace Matron Gu Yanli.role: Terrace attendant of the Nine-Heavens Rebirth Terrace, keeper of the cradle formations and the rebirth ledger
Terrace Matron Gu Yanli.personality: Brisk, kind in deeds rather than words, unimpressed by any rank a soul held in a previous life; treats a weeping newborn immortal and a fallen court minister identically, because on the terrace they are.
Terrace Matron Gu Yanli.speech: Short terrace idiom; calls everyone 'child' whatever they used to be, and answers questions about the court by pointing at the sky filter.
Terrace Matron Gu Yanli.want: Keep every cradle formation whole and every newborn breathing until their body can bear the unfiltered sky, and keep the court paying for it.
Terrace Matron Gu Yanli.fear: That the visiting elder will find the face he is looking for among her charges, and that the court will decide the terrace is a liability the day after.
Terrace Matron Gu Yanli.secret: The servant caught copying names was hers. She keeps a second ledger of which reborn souls carry old-court blood and moves them to the inner ring before the court's inspectors reach the outer one.

Provincial Registrar Mo Qingyan.role: Registrar of reborn souls and clerk of the sovereign law formation in the Celestial Cradle Province
Provincial Registrar Mo Qingyan.personality: Meticulous, courteous, quietly frightened; believes a correct entry in the register is the only protection a mortal-strength body has in the Celestial World, and behaves accordingly.
Provincial Registrar Mo Qingyan.speech: Formal registrar's phrasing; answers a question with a question about which form it belongs on, and lowers her voice whenever the formation's hum changes pitch.
Provincial Registrar Mo Qingyan.want: Every reborn soul registered under a name that will keep it alive, and the formation's note back where it was last season.
Provincial Registrar Mo Qingyan.fear: That the sovereign law formation has begun choosing which souls it shelters, and that the register is recording its choices rather than the Empress's.
Provincial Registrar Mo Qingyan.secret: Not every re-registration order arrives from the Celestial Mandate Palace. Some appear sealed on her desk in her own handwriting, and she files them, because the families named in them are the ones the formation stops crushing.

Exchange Warden Bai Ruolan.speech: Formal, brisk and courtly; every sentence ends where the ledger says it should.
Exchange Warden Bai Ruolan.want: Keep the Exchange's imperial licence unblemished and its ledgers balanced to the last stone.
Exchange Warden Bai Ruolan.fear: A lot traced to a forbidden art passing under her seal, and the throne's auditors arriving to ask how.
Exchange Warden Bai Ruolan.personality: Precise, unhurried, incorruptible in public and pragmatic in private; remembers every face that has ever bid.
Exchange Warden Bai Ruolan.secret: She keeps a private list of which noble houses are quietly selling heirlooms to stay solvent, and sells silence about it.

Pavilion Mistress Wen Qingluo.speech: Soft, elegant and faintly amused; she never raises her voice and never repeats a price.
Pavilion Mistress Wen Qingluo.want: Keep the ascended families bidding against one another in her pavilion rather than settling matters outside it.
Pavilion Mistress Wen Qingluo.fear: Two great families deciding the pavilion's neutrality is worth less than a single lot.
Pavilion Mistress Wen Qingluo.personality: Serene, watchful and endlessly patient; treats every bidder as a guest and every guest as a ledger entry.
Pavilion Mistress Wen Qingluo.secret: She brokers marriages between ascended families in the same private rooms she brokers heirlooms, and takes a fee for both.

Hall Arbiter Gu Zhenhai.speech: Measured and judicial; he speaks in rulings and expects them to be recorded.
Hall Arbiter Gu Zhenhai.want: Keep the Treasure Hall the one place in the Immortal World where clans settle a matter with stones instead of war.
Hall Arbiter Gu Zhenhai.fear: A relic passing through his hall that the Court's law cannot bind, and the Court asking why he let it.
Hall Arbiter Gu Zhenhai.personality: Grave, exact, incorruptible about the law and generous about everything the law does not cover.
Hall Arbiter Gu Zhenhai.secret: He has quietly ruled in favour of the same clan three times, and keeps the case records where only he can read them.

Mandate Steward Xie Lingzhen.speech: Courtly, distant and precise; she addresses sovereigns and disciples in exactly the same tone.
Mandate Steward Xie Lingzhen.want: Keep the Mandate's hall above every faction's quarrel and every sovereign's pride.
Mandate Steward Xie Lingzhen.fear: A sovereign deciding the Mandate's shelter does not apply to him, and being right.
Mandate Steward Xie Lingzhen.personality: Composed to the point of stillness, formidably well informed, and courteous as a blade is polished.
Mandate Steward Xie Lingzhen.secret: She has withdrawn lots by 'decree' on her own authority more than once, and heaven has never contradicted her.

quests.title: Nine Cycles of Purification
quests.description: Refine the impurities left in your {realm} cultivation until only the purest qi remains.
quests.clue: Purity is gained by repeatedly discarding what is unworthy.

quests.title: Twelve Meridian Tempering
quests.description: Temper the major meridians so your {root} qi can circulate without hidden weakness.
quests.clue: A perfect vessel cannot have a single weak channel.

quests.title: A Worthy Opponent
quests.description: Seek pressure appropriate to a {path}; perfection needs adversity, not safe meditation alone.

quests.title: Heaven-and-Earth Resonance
quests.description: Find a place where natural qi resonates with your {root} spiritual root and comprehend its rhythm.
quests.clue: The world is the oldest cultivation manual.

quests.title: The Unbroken Foundation
quests.description: Repair hidden instabilities accumulated through the entire {realm} realm.
quests.clue: Perfection is often repair rather than accumulation.

quests.title: Heart Demon Reflection
quests.description: Confront an inner contradiction before it grows into a future heart demon.
quests.clue: A flaw denied becomes a chain.

quests.title: Touch the Realm Limit
quests.description: Compress body, qi, spirit and intent until you can sense the boundary mortals call impossible.
quests.clue: The final wall only appears after every lesser flaw is removed.

verdant_furnace_legacy.name: Verdant Furnace Legacy
verdant_furnace_legacy.description: A lost alchemical inheritance teaching medicinal harmony, flame restraint and adaptive pill formulas.

nine_echo_sword_legacy.name: Nine-Echo Sword Legacy
nine_echo_sword_legacy.description: Nine sword echoes that teach intent, timing and how one strike can contain many answers.

stygian_keeper_legacy.name: Stygian Keeper Legacy
stygian_keeper_legacy.description: A forbidden soul inheritance dealing with ghosts, corpse echoes and the boundary between life and death.

verdant_immortal_grotto.name: Verdant Immortal Grotto
verdant_immortal_grotto.description: A sealed medicinal grotto where an ancient alchemist cultivated a garden that has continued growing without sunlight.

rooms.name: The Door of Withered Vines
rooms.description: Dead vines awaken as a living formation and test whether intruders can read the flow of medicinal qi.

rooms.name: Frostfire Garden
rooms.description: Fire and ice spiritual plants grow intertwined while a territorial spirit beast sleeps among them.

rooms.name: Broken Pill Hall
rooms.description: Hundreds of failed pills litter the floor. The surviving furnace still contains a dangerous natural flame spark.

rooms.name: Verdant Inheritance Chamber
rooms.description: A jade furnace floats above a dry spiritual spring. The final trial asks whether the cultivator understands restraint rather than raw heat.

sword_grave_nine_echoes.name: Sword Grave of Nine Echoes
sword_grave_nine_echoes.description: A drifting graveyard of broken swords where every footstep returns as a blade-like echo.

rooms.name: Field of Broken Blades
rooms.description: Thousands of abandoned weapons resonate with hostile intent.

rooms.name: Echo Bridge
rooms.description: Invisible sword intent cuts across a narrow stone bridge in repeating patterns.

rooms.name: Hall of the Unswung Sword
rooms.description: The strongest pressure comes from a sword that has never once left its sheath.

rooms.name: Nine-Echo Tablet
rooms.description: Nine ancient sword marks ask for a response not of strength but of intent.

stygian_lantern_tomb.name: Stygian Lantern Tomb
stygian_lantern_tomb.description: A tomb that appears beneath old graves only when nine corpse-lanterns burn with blue fire.

rooms.name: Whispering Stair
rooms.description: The dead murmur truths and lies in equal measure while the staircase changes behind you.

rooms.name: Hall of Borrowed Faces
rooms.description: Funeral masks repeat the voices of people the intruder once knew.

rooms.name: River Without Water
rooms.description: A black river of memory must be crossed without surrendering identity to the dead.

rooms.name: Keeper's Seal
rooms.description: A lesser seal of the underworld floats above a coffin whose owner is still speaking.

unexpected_events.title: Sudden Spiritual Qi Storm
unexpected_events.description: The local spiritual currents overturn without warning, making cultivation dangerous but unusually rich.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: Spirit resources swell while unstable currents unsettle settlements and local markets.

world_effect.history: A sudden spiritual qi storm enriched the local veins and disrupted ordinary life.

unexpected_events.title: Heavenly Herb Bloom
unexpected_events.description: A rare medicinal plant matures early under a brief heaven-and-earth phenomenon.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: Medicinal abundance draws gatherers, raises resource prosperity, and temporarily shifts herb demand.

world_effect.history: A heavenly herb bloom drew medicine gatherers and enriched the region.

unexpected_events.title: A Wounded Wandering Senior
unexpected_events.description: A badly wounded cultivator appears where no traveler should be, refusing to reveal who is hunting them.

unexpected_events.title: Whisper of a Cursed Relic
unexpected_events.description: A buried object calls directly to the cultivator through dreams that last only a heartbeat.

unexpected_events.title: Spirit-Beast Migration
unexpected_events.description: Spirit beasts flee through the region in numbers, suggesting something stronger is moving behind them.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: Fleeing beasts strain roads and food stores while beast materials enter local trade.

world_effect.history: A mass spirit-beast migration damaged roads, strained food stores, and flooded hunters' markets.

unexpected_events.title: A Medicinal Rift Opens
unexpected_events.description: Space folds around the scent of ancient medicine. A hidden grotto is opening.

unexpected_events.title: Nine Sword Echoes Ring
unexpected_events.description: Nine sword cries sound from nowhere, and a broken stone gate appears between the cliffs.

unexpected_events.title: Nine Corpse-Lanterns Ignite
unexpected_events.description: Blue corpse-fire appears beneath old graves. A tomb that should not exist is becoming reachable.

unexpected_events.title: Ancient Ruin Appears
unexpected_events.description: A hidden palace of broken pagodas rises from the cliffs, exposing a gate into an ancient sword grave.

unexpected_events.title: Heavenly Treasure Descends
unexpected_events.description: Golden clouds split as a sealed treasure falls from the heavens. Cultivators, clans, and hidden experts converge before anyone can identify it.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: Spirit resources rise, but treasure-seekers destabilize the area and drive up demand.

world_effect.history: A heavenly treasure descended, enriching local spirit currents and drawing dangerous competition.

unexpected_events.title: Major Sect Recruitment
unexpected_events.description: A major sect delegation raises testing platforms and examines spiritual roots, physiques, bloodlines, discipline, and character.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: Migration and recruitment pressure increase while sects spend resources competing for talent.

world_effect.history: Sect recruitment platforms drew ambitious youths and their families into the region.

unexpected_events.title: Beast Tide
unexpected_events.description: Thousands of demonic beasts surge from the wilderness toward walls, roads, farms, and spirit-resource sites.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: The tide causes casualties, food shortages, migration, insecurity, and a regional market shock even without player intervention.

world_effect.history: A demonic beast tide struck the region, damaging settlements, roads, farms, and spirit-resource sites.

unexpected_events.title: Secret Inheritance Revealed
unexpected_events.description: A collapsed tomb reveals an ancient jade furnace and a trial-path leading toward a sealed inheritance chamber.

unexpected_events.title: Lightning Tribulation
unexpected_events.description: A nearby breakthrough summons layered heavenly lightning. Every bolt scars the land and enriches the surviving spirit currents.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: Security falls around the strike zone while damaged terrain becomes unusually rich in spiritual energy.

world_effect.history: A cultivator's lightning tribulation scarred the land and transformed the local spiritual currents.

unexpected_events.title: Demonic Cultivator Incident
unexpected_events.description: An apparently ordinary settlement is exposed as the center of a forbidden ritual fed by missing travelers and stolen vitality.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: The discovery raises unrest, reduces security, and disrupts nearby trade.

world_effect.history: A forbidden demonic ritual was exposed inside an ordinary settlement.

unexpected_events.title: Auction House Chaos
unexpected_events.description: A supposedly worthless lot reveals a hidden treasure aura. Bids explode, private rooms unseal, and every faction begins calculating who must not leave with it.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: Auction speculation increases prosperity and unrest while distorting local prices and demand.

world_effect.history: A misidentified auction lot triggered a bidding war and intense faction speculation.

unexpected_events.title: Young Master Confrontation
unexpected_events.description: An arrogant heir takes offense over a seat, treasure, companion, beast, or even a patch of grass. Their retainers make certain the misunderstanding escalates spectacularly.

unexpected_events.title: Mysterious Old Beggar
unexpected_events.description: A ragged old beggar asks for food and courtesy. The pressure hidden behind their clouded eyes suggests an ancient expert testing character rather than wealth.

unexpected_events.title: Celestial Descendant in Disguise
unexpected_events.description: A quiet traveler with impossible manners and a concealed lineage asks seemingly ordinary questions while hidden guardians watch from beyond spiritual sense.

unexpected_events.title: Spatial Rift
unexpected_events.description: A crack in reality begins swallowing loose objects, beasts, and pieces of nearby structures. Blue lantern-light flickers beyond the tear.

unexpected_events.title: Ancient Bloodline Awakening
unexpected_events.description: A nearby cultivator suddenly manifests the aura of an ancient divine bloodline, causing dormant lineage marks in the crowd to tremble in response.

unexpected_events.title: Sect Tournament
unexpected_events.description: Sect disciples gather to fight for rankings, resources, weapons, prestige, and qualification for future secret-realm expeditions.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: Visitors enrich the region while sect competition consumes resources and increases recruitment pressure.

world_effect.history: A sect tournament drew disciples, merchants, scouts, and rival elders into the region.

unexpected_events.title: Spirit Herb Mutation
unexpected_events.description: A common medicinal plant absorbs an abnormal qi current and transforms into a treasure with centuries of condensed vitality.

unexpected_events.title: Meteor from the Heavens
unexpected_events.description: A burning object crashes beyond the horizon. Within the crater may be an artifact, corpse, egg, sealed remnant, or imprisoned being.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: The impact enriches spirit resources but damages security and draws treasure hunters.

world_effect.history: A heavenly meteor struck nearby, creating a resource-rich crater contested by treasure hunters.

unexpected_events.title: Ancient Soul Possession
unexpected_events.description: An ancient cultivator's remnant soul wakes inside an apparently ordinary person, leaking memories and a pressure that does not belong to this era.

player_effect.name: Remnant Soul Echo
player_effect.description: Foreign memories sharpen spiritual perception but strain the will.

unexpected_events.title: Demon Invasion
unexpected_events.description: Demonic forces cross a weakened boundary and attack settlements, sect outposts, resource sites, and transport routes.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: Population, security, food, resources, sect treasuries, and market supply all suffer a severe persistent shock.

world_effect.history: A demonic invasion crossed into the region and overwhelmed settlements, roads, and sect defenses.

unexpected_events.title: Nine-Colored Heavenly Phenomenon
unexpected_events.description: Nine-colored clouds, golden lotuses, divine music, and impossible stars announce that someone nearby achieved an absurd breakthrough.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: The phenomenon enriches local qi and attracts cultivators, merchants, and sect scouts.

world_effect.history: A nine-colored heavenly phenomenon announced an extraordinary breakthrough.

unexpected_events.title: Political Marriage Arrangement
unexpected_events.description: Two sects or martial clans attempt to bind bloodlines and interests through a political marriage. Every polite sentence conceals an alliance calculation.

unexpected_events.title: Cultivation Market Scam
unexpected_events.description: A merchant sells a cheap-looking object as worthless junk. Beneath the grime is a fragment of an ancient formation secret the seller never recognized.

unexpected_events.title: Time-Distortion Formation
unexpected_events.description: A damaged formation creates a pocket where hours outside feel like years of meditation inside, though memory and qi strain remain real.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: The formation enriches local spatial qi; participants can claim a temporary cultivation afterglow once.

world_effect.history: A time-distortion formation destabilized local space and enriched spatial qi.

player_effect.name: Time-Distortion Afterglow
player_effect.description: Compressed meditation memories briefly improve cultivation efficiency.

unexpected_events.title: The Dead City
unexpected_events.description: Travelers find an entire city standing silent and intact, yet every inhabitant vanished overnight without signs of flight or battle.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: Population collapses locally, trade avoids the region, and fear drives migration and unrest.

world_effect.history: An inhabited district became a dead city overnight, with its population missing and no clear cause.

unexpected_events.title: A Dragon Appears
unexpected_events.description: A true dragon descends through the clouds. Its intent is unreadable, its presence crushes weaker beasts, and it is very much not necessarily friendly.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: The dragon's aura disrupts security and trade while awakening nearby spirit veins.

world_effect.history: A dragon appeared over the region, suppressing beasts and cultivators while awakening local spirit veins.

unexpected_events.title: Fate Encounter
unexpected_events.description: A stranger in need may later become a hidden expert, future ruler, reincarnator, benefactor, or terrifying enemy. The choice to help is recorded by fate.

unexpected_events.title: Heaven's Chosen Appears
unexpected_events.description: A ridiculously talented young cultivator arrives, shatters local records, attracts every sect's attention, and immediately becomes everyone's political problem.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: Sect recruitment and doctrine pressure rise as factions compete to claim or contain the prodigy.

world_effect.history: A Heaven's Chosen shattered local records and triggered fierce sect competition.

unexpected_events.title: Forbidden Zone Opens
unexpected_events.description: A prohibition seal that endured for thousands of years breaks. Corpse-lanterns reveal a route into the forbidden tomb below.

unexpected_events.title: Reincarnated Expert Awakens
unexpected_events.description: An unremarkable cultivator suddenly remembers a previous life, recognizes ancient techniques at a glance, and begins rebuilding with frightening efficiency.

unexpected_events.title: Artifact Chooses Its Master
unexpected_events.description: A legendary artifact rejects every acclaimed genius, then flies into the hands of the person nobody expected it to acknowledge.

unexpected_events.title: Heavenly Punishment
unexpected_events.description: An ancient rule is violated by accident. Dark clouds gather around the offender alone, and the heavens mark the debt before the first bolt falls.

player_effect.name: Heavenly Punishment Mark
player_effect.description: Heavenly pressure hinders cultivation and tests resolve until the mark fades.

unexpected_events.title: Cultivation World's Festival
unexpected_events.description: Cultivators gather for trading, poetry, music, drinking, friendly competitions, matchmaking, and the statistically inevitable trouble.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: The festival improves prosperity and security while increasing trade, demand, and sect recruitment.

world_effect.history: A cultivation festival filled the region with trade, performances, competitions, and new alliances.

quests.title: Skin Without Flaw
quests.description: Temper the outer body until ordinary weakness has nowhere left to hide in your {realm}.

quests.title: Bones Like Spirit Iron
quests.description: Reforge the framework of the body through pressure, impact, and medicinal tempering.
quests.clue: A body that fears pain can never become unbreakable.

quests.title: Twelve Meridian Furnace
quests.description: Drive blood and body essence through every major meridian without tearing them.
quests.clue: The meridians are roads; perfection demands that none remain narrow.

quests.title: Blood Roars Like Thunder
quests.description: Condense vitality until each heartbeat carries the force of your cultivation path.
quests.clue: Blood is not merely life; it is the army that carries life.

quests.title: Marrow Rebirth
quests.description: Purge old weakness from the deepest parts of the body and regrow stronger marrow.
quests.clue: To be reborn, the old body must first be surpassed.

quests.title: Body and Dao in Accord
quests.description: Use insight to make your physical form resonate with the principles you cultivate.
quests.clue: The strongest body is one that agrees with its Dao.

quests.title: A Worthy Vessel
quests.description: Prove through battle, hardship, or impossible exertion that your body can contain greater power.
quests.clue: Power without a vessel becomes self-destruction.

sect_system.resource_policy: Sect members donate materials for contribution points. Higher ranks and accumulated influence determine political weight; contribution points can be exchanged for stocked sect resources.

recruitment.description: Applicants demonstrate stable foundations, qi control and the judgment expected of an orthodox sword sect.
Applicants identify medicinal materials, stabilize furnace flame and prove that their qi will not ruin a batch under pressure.
Applicants cross a cold formation while preserving clarity, restraint and precise control of spiritual energy.

Black Serpent Clan.specialty: Poisons, beast blood and ambush arts

recruitment.description: Applicants navigate venomous terrain, read beast behavior and prove they can survive without wasting valuable creatures.

Blood River Sect.specialty: Blood refinement, sacrificial arts and battlefield harvesting

recruitment.description: Only invited or discovered applicants reach the gorge. The test values survival instinct, resolve and willingness to bear the consequences of a hunted path.

Corpse Lantern Pavilion.specialty: Soul lanterns, corpse refinement, ghost techniques and forbidden inscriptions

recruitment.description: Invited applicants keep vigil among bound memories and must distinguish fear, grief and spiritual deception without losing their own identity.

Heaven-Devouring Demon Sect.description: A concealed cross-world lineage that recruits cultivators already stained by severe karma debt.

golden_pavilion.name: Golden Pavilion Auction House
golden_pavilion.description: Violence is suppressed by formations and hidden guards inside. Once a bidder leaves through the doors, the Pavilion no longer guarantees protection.

azure_crown_exchange.name: Azure Crown Treasure Exchange
azure_crown_exchange.description: The imperial capital's licensed exchange: imperial guards and a court formation keep the floor bloodless. The licence ends at the gate, and so does the guard.

spirit_jade_pavilion.name: Spirit Jade Auction Pavilion
spirit_jade_pavilion.description: Ascended families and old sects trade under a jade array that suppresses every technique on the floor. Past the jade doors the array, and its courtesy, end.

nine_heavens_hall.name: Nine-Heavens Treasure Hall
nine_heavens_hall.description: Immortal clans auction under the Court's own law formation, which forbids a raised hand as firmly as a raised blade. The law stops at the hall's threshold.

celestial_mandate_hall.name: Celestial Mandate Auction Hall
celestial_mandate_hall.description: Sovereign courts trade under the Mandate itself; a blow struck on this floor is a blow against heaven. The Mandate's shelter ends at the hall doors.

folded_step.name: Folded Step
folded_step.description: Fold a short span of space to reposition instantly.

spatial_lockdown.name: Spatial Lockdown
spatial_lockdown.description: Freeze local space around an opponent, suppressing movement and escape.

spatial_strangulation.name: Spatial Strangulation
spatial_strangulation.description: Compress the space surrounding a target into a crushing prison.

space_domain.name: Space Dominion
space_domain.description: Project a domain in which the user controls distance, direction, and spatial stability.

world_collapse.name: World Collapse
world_collapse.description: Use a stabilized personal world as a conceptual weapon against another domain.

spatial_lockdown.name: Spatial Lockdown
spatial_lockdown.description: Local space is frozen. Movement, flight, and escape are suppressed.

spatial_strangulation.name: Spatial Strangulation
spatial_strangulation.description: Space compresses inward, bypassing ordinary physical positioning and crushing the target.

space_domain.name: Space Dominion
space_domain.description: Within this domain, distance and direction bend toward the cultivator’s will.

abode_cultivation_focus.name: Cave Abode Cultivation Focus
abode_cultivation_focus.description: A stabilized cultivation chamber improves local qi circulation.

forge_inspiration.name: Forge Inspiration
forge_inspiration.description: The private forge and formation-fed furnace improve forging control.

alchemy_inspiration.name: Alchemy Inspiration
alchemy_inspiration.description: A private medicine room improves flame and medicinal-energy control.

Mortal World:
{encounter}

The ordinary sounds of {location} - cart wheels, a dog, wind in dry grass - carry on around it, as if the world has not yet decided this matters. {name} has the next move.

{encounter}

Dust settles. Nothing here presses for an answer, and nothing offers one; the moment simply waits at {location} for {name} to act on it.

{encounter}

At {location} the air is plain and the ground is honest, and whatever this becomes will be decided by what {name} does next, not by any sign from the heavens.
Spiritual World:
{encounter}

Thin spirit qi moves through {location} like a current under ice, and it bends a little toward the scene. {name} feels it and holds still; the choice is still theirs.

{encounter}

The light at {location} has the faint, washed clarity of the Spiritual World, and in it the situation stands sharp-edged and unresolved. It waits on {name}.

{encounter}

Somewhere above {location} a formation hums that mortals would never hear. Down here, nothing has committed itself. {name} decides what happens next.
Immortal World:
{encounter}

At {location} the qi is dense enough to taste, and it carries the weight of things that have stood for ten thousand years. The scene does not hurry {name}; it has all the time there is.

{encounter}

The Immortal World does not explain itself. {location} offers the situation whole and says nothing further, and {name} must choose without being told the stakes.

{encounter}

A stillness settles over {location} that is not peace but attention, as if the land itself were watching to see what {name} will do.
Celestial World:
{encounter}

At {location} the laws of the Celestial World press close, and even an unresolved moment feels weighed and recorded. {name} stands in it, unhurried and unforgiven.

{encounter}

The air of {location} is so clear it rings. Nothing here is accidental, and nothing has yet been decided; the next decision belongs to {name}.

{encounter}

High over {location}, something vast turns its regard elsewhere. The scene remains, exact and open, for {name} to answer.

Mortal World: The clash with the **{beast}** ends in your favor near {location}. It can no longer contest the hunt, and the immediate struggle falls still.
Mud, torn brush, and then quiet: the **{beast}** is down, and {location} goes back to being an ordinary place with one less thing in it.
The **{beast}** gives one last lunge and falls short. The hunt at {location} is yours; the ground is trampled and the air smells of blood and crushed grass.
Spiritual World: The **{beast}** falters as its qi scatters, and the hunt at {location} closes in your favor. What it was is settling back into the land.
Spirit light flickers along the wounds you opened; then the **{beast}** is still. {location} holds its breath a moment longer and then lets it go.
The **{beast}** breaks under the last exchange. Around {location} the thin spirit qi stirs, drawn briefly to the kill, and drifts on.
Immortal World: The **{beast}** falls, and the dense qi of {location} closes over the place it stood like water over a dropped stone. The hunt is yours.
An old creature dies slowly and with dignity. The **{beast}** does both, and {location} keeps its silence as the struggle ends in your favor.
Your last strike lands where the **{beast}** had no more strength to guard. It goes down at {location}, and the immortal land takes no notice at all.
Celestial World: The **{beast}** yields to the final exchange, and for a heartbeat the laws that hold {location} together seem to weigh what you have done. The hunt is yours.
The **{beast}** falls with a sound like a bell struck once. At {location}, nothing else moves; the struggle is finished and the outcome is plainly yours.
Even here, a kill is a kill. The **{beast}** is down at {location}, and the clear celestial air does not soften it.

Mortal World: The **{beast}** breaks away before the hunt can be completed, leaving distance and disturbed ground between hunter and quarry at {location}.
A wrong step, a wrong moment, and the **{beast}** is gone into the cover around {location}. You are unhurt and it is unhurt, and the hunt is over for now.
The **{beast}** slips the exchange and puts {location} between you. Nothing is lost but the chance.
Spiritual World: The **{beast}** twists out of reach on a thread of spirit qi and is gone from {location}. You keep your footing and your hide; the hunt does not.
For a moment the **{beast}** is there in the pale light of {location}, then it is not, and the air closes over the place it stood.
The **{beast}** reads your intent a breath before you commit and is already moving. {location} swallows it. The hunt ends without a kill.
Immortal World: The **{beast}** withdraws through the dense qi of {location} as if through a door, and the hunt closes without a result. It will remember you; that is all.
You lose the **{beast}** in the deep stillness of {location}. Nothing was taken from you, and nothing was won.
The **{beast}** declines the fight and vanishes into the old land around {location}. The hunt is over, unfinished.
Celestial World: The **{beast}** parts from the clash and is gone across {location} before your next breath. In the Celestial World, that is a kind of answer.
The **{beast}** slips the exchange with contempt and leaves {location} to you. You are whole; the hunt is not.
Between one heartbeat and the next the **{beast}** is elsewhere. {location} keeps its clear silence, and the hunt ends without a kill.

Mortal World: At **{location}**, the surroundings react in small, ordinary ways - a glance, a shift of weight, the quiet of people deciding not to notice. Nothing requiring a mechanical check resolves on its own; say more, or use **/action** to test it.
The moment passes at **{location}** without anything committing itself. {name}'s intent is understood by the scene but not yet tested; a clearer aim, or **/action**, would settle it.
At **{location}** the world takes the attempt in and gives nothing back yet. What it becomes depends on a more specific move, or on **/action** to put it to a check.
Spiritual World: At **{location}** the thin spirit qi answers {name}'s intent with a faint stir and no verdict. Nothing is resolved by itself; a more specific aim, or **/action**, would test it.
The scene at **{location}** acknowledges the attempt the way the Spiritual World acknowledges most things: quietly, and without deciding. Use **/action** when the attempt should make a check.
At **{location}**, {name}'s move leaves a ripple in the local qi and nothing more. Say what it is aimed at, or use **/action** to let the dice weigh it.
Immortal World: At **{location}** the dense qi of the Immortal World absorbs {name}'s intent without comment. Nothing resolves on its own here; a sharper aim, or **/action**, would.
The old land around **{location}** does not react to gestures. {name}'s attempt stands unanswered until it is made specific, or put to a check with **/action**.
At **{location}** the scene holds still around the attempt, neither refusing nor yielding. Describe the exact intent, or use **/action** to test it.
Celestial World: At **{location}** the laws of the Celestial World note {name}'s intent and withhold judgment. Nothing is resolved automatically; state the aim, or use **/action** to make the check.
The clear air of **{location}** carries the attempt and returns no answer. In this world an act is weighed when it is committed - use **/action** to commit it.
At **{location}** {name}'s move is seen, and that is all that happens. A more specific intent, or **/action**, would put it to the test.

Mortal World: **{npc}** turns their attention fully to you. "I heard you." They leave the rest unsaid rather than offer an answer they are unwilling to give.
**{npc}** considers you for a moment, then goes back to what they were doing. "Say it plainer, or say it later."
**{npc}** nods once, slowly. It is not agreement, and it is not refusal; it is the look of someone who will remember what you said.
Spiritual World: **{npc}** lets the silence stretch a breath longer than is comfortable. "I heard you." Nothing more is offered, and nothing is denied.
**{npc}** studies you with the patience of someone whose years are not counted in seasons. "We will see," they say, and mean exactly that.
**{npc}** inclines their head a fraction. "Noted." The word carries more weight here than it would below.
Immortal World: **{npc}** regards you as an old tree regards weather. "I heard you," they say, and the matter is neither settled nor dismissed.
**{npc}** does not answer at once. When they do, it is only, "Go on," and the qi around them does not so much as stir.
**{npc}** turns their gaze on you, and for a moment the age of them is plain. "Speak clearly, or not at all."
Celestial World: **{npc}** hears you out without expression. "So you say." In the Celestial World, that is not nothing.
**{npc}** looks at you the way the sky looks at a bird. "I have heard." They do not say what they will do with it.
**{npc}** allows a pause that could hold a lifetime. "Continue," they say, and the word is a door left ajar.

Mortal World: The gathered power crosses the threshold cleanly and settles into **{realm}, Stage {stage}**, its new rhythm steady rather than collapsing back on itself.
Something gives, and then something holds. The cultivation base finds its new footing in **{realm}, Stage {stage}**, and the body knows it before the mind does.
The qi that strained at the barrier pours through and stills. **{realm}, Stage {stage}** - the meridians settle into it like a river finding a wider bed.
Spiritual World: The barrier thins, parts, and closes behind you. **{realm}, Stage {stage}** settles in with a clarity the Spiritual World lends to those who earn it.
The gathered power crosses over and holds. **{realm}, Stage {stage}**: the world's thin qi threads itself through the new base and stays.
There is a moment of falling and then of standing on something solid. **{realm}, Stage {stage}** is yours, steady and quiet.
Immortal World: The threshold gives way like old stone under patient water. **{realm}, Stage {stage}** settles deep, the dense qi of the Immortal World filling every channel it opens.
The power crosses cleanly and the Immortal World, which notices little, notices this. **{realm}, Stage {stage}** holds.
A long pressure ends. **{realm}, Stage {stage}** settles into place with the finality of a door closing on a room you will not enter again.
Celestial World: The gathered power crosses the threshold and the laws of the Celestial World accept it. **{realm}, Stage {stage}** settles in, exact and permanent.
The barrier does not break; it acknowledges you and stands aside. **{realm}, Stage {stage}** holds, and the clear air rings with it.
Something in the heavens is amended. **{realm}, Stage {stage}**: the new base settles, and nothing that follows will be quite as it was.

Mortal World: The gathered power reaches the threshold but does not stabilize beyond it. The attempt disperses without carrying the cultivation base into **{realm}, Stage {stage}**.
For a breath it is almost there. Then the pressure slips, the qi scatters back to where it was, and **{realm}, Stage {stage}** remains a step away.
The barrier holds. The power that pressed against it drains back, and the body is left tired and whole, **{realm}, Stage {stage}** untouched.
Spiritual World: The threshold to **{realm}, Stage {stage}** thins and does not part. The gathered qi settles back, unspent and unwilling.
The attempt reaches the edge and finds nothing to hold. The Spiritual World offers no second chance in this breath; **{realm}, Stage {stage}** waits.
The power gathers, rises, and falls back like a tide that did not quite reach the mark. **{realm}, Stage {stage}** stays where it was.
Immortal World: The Immortal World's dense qi presses back harder than the attempt pushed. **{realm}, Stage {stage}** does not open, and the gathered power disperses without harm.
The threshold to **{realm}, Stage {stage}** stands like a mountain and the attempt, for all its force, is weather. It passes.
Almost. The word hangs in the channels as the power drains back, and **{realm}, Stage {stage}** remains on the far side of the barrier.
Celestial World: The laws of the Celestial World weigh the attempt and find it not yet enough. **{realm}, Stage {stage}** does not open; the gathered power disperses without judgment.
The barrier to **{realm}, Stage {stage}** answers with silence. What was gathered scatters, and nothing is taken but the moment.
The threshold acknowledges the attempt and declines it. **{realm}, Stage {stage}** waits, unmoved; the cultivator is unharmed and unfinished.

homestead.name: Homestead
homestead.description: A cultivator's one home. It begins as a cultivation chamber and a storeroom; the herb garden, alchemy furnace, forge, formation core, beast pen, merchant hall and defensive formation are built and raised with upgrades.

cave_abode.name: Cave Abode
cave_abode.description: A secluded cultivation residence balanced around cultivation, storage and formations. Retired at v0.30.1: a sect assigns its disciples an abode, and the property a player founds is the homestead.

alchemy_estate.name: Alchemy Estate
alchemy_estate.description: A private estate centered on pill refinement, medicinal herbs and secure storage.

spirit_herb_estate.name: Spirit Herb Estate
spirit_herb_estate.description: A spiritual garden estate specializing in herb cultivation and medicinal preparation.

spirit_beast_ranch.name: Spirit Beast Ranch
spirit_beast_ranch.description: A protected private holding for contracted beasts, training and recovery.

merchant_pavilion.name: Merchant Pavilion
merchant_pavilion.description: A player-owned commercial residence with expanded storage and merchant facilities.

clan_estate.name: Clan Estate
clan_estate.description: A fortified family estate suited to cultivation, guests, formations and long-term clan scenes.

forbidden_arts.description: Blood, soul-devouring, corpse, sacrificial and predatory cultivation arts are forbidden by most orthodox jurisdictions. Public use creates evidence and political consequences; demonic factions may approve of the same act.

family_principles: Families protect bloodline survival and reputation before abstract ideology.
A publicly exposed forbidden cultivator can cost their family alliances, stability and face.
Powerful families may hide a useful demonic heir while weak families may disown them to survive.
Blood feuds and succession crises persist across player deaths and reincarnations.
npc_principles: NPCs act according to faction, fear, ambition, memory and local law rather than player convenience.
Orthodox witnesses can report forbidden arts; demonic witnesses may respect or recruit the user.
NPC death is canonical and may weaken families, sects, markets and regional security.
sect_principles: Orthodox sects punish exposed forbidden arts unless leadership chooses secrecy or expediency.
Demonic sects reward effective forbidden cultivation but punish weakness and resource waste.
Sect policy, cohesion, resources and internal factions continue changing during player seclusion.

blood_sea_scripture.name: Blood Sea Scripture
blood_sea_scripture.description: Refines blood essence into violent crimson qi. Fast, potent, and corrosive to the Dao Heart.
