azure_cloud_foundation_sword_canon.name: Azure Cloud Foundation Sword Canon
azure_cloud_foundation_sword_canon.description: The Azure Cloud Sect's first teaching: a steady stance, a clean draw, and qi that settles before it moves. Every outer disciple learns it before anything else.

crimson_furnace_ember_tempering_record.name: Crimson Furnace Ember-Tempering Record
crimson_furnace_ember_tempering_record.description: Breath and fire in one rhythm. The Crimson Furnace Sect teaches its newest disciples to hold an ember in the meridians without being burned by it.

frozen_moon_first_frost_sutra.name: Frozen Moon First-Frost Sutra
frozen_moon_first_frost_sutra.description: Stillness before technique. The Frozen Moon Palace's entry sutra teaches qi to slow, cool and hold a shape - the ground every formation is later built on.

black_serpent_venom_fang_primer.name: Black Serpent Venom-Fang Primer
black_serpent_venom_fang_primer.description: Strike low, strike once, leave. The Black Serpent Clan's primer teaches its new blood to move unseen and to make the first bite count.

blood_river_crimson_tide_initiation.name: Blood River Crimson Tide Initiation
blood_river_crimson_tide_initiation.description: The first lesson of the Blood River Sect: blood is qi that has not yet been spent. A forbidden foundation that grows stronger the more it costs.

corpse_lantern_pale_flame_initiation.name: Corpse Lantern Pale-Flame Initiation
corpse_lantern_pale_flame_initiation.description: Light a lantern with what should have gone dark. The Corpse Lantern Pavilion's initiation teaches a new disciple to bind the first pale flame.

blood_sea_palm.name: Blood Sea Palm
blood_sea_palm.description: A palm strike carrying corrosive blood qi.

scarlet_rebirth.name: Scarlet Rebirth
scarlet_rebirth.description: Burns blood essence to force wounds closed.

soul_rend.name: Soul Rend
soul_rend.description: A spiritual tear aimed directly at the opponent’s soul.

ghost_lantern_bind.name: Ghost Lantern Bind
ghost_lantern_bind.description: Ghost-fire chains suppress the target’s actions.

white_bone_claw.name: White Bone Claw
white_bone_claw.description: Corpse-yin hardens the fingers into tearing bone claws.

corpse_armor.name: Corpse Armor
corpse_armor.description: Death qi temporarily seals flesh and deadens pain.

black_miasma_finger.name: Black Miasma Finger
black_miasma_finger.description: Condenses poisonous qi into a piercing finger strike.

venomous_meridian_seal.name: Venomous Meridian Seal
venomous_meridian_seal.description: Poison qi clogs the target’s meridian circulation.

heart_demon_whisper.name: Heart-Demon Whisper
heart_demon_whisper.description: A whisper that turns unresolved fear into a weapon.

seven_emotion_collapse.name: Seven-Emotion Collapse
seven_emotion_collapse.description: Overloads the seven emotions until mind and qi collapse together.

life_burning_demon_flame.name: Life-Burning Demon Flame
life_burning_demon_flame.description: Sacrifices life force to ignite black-red demonic flame.

netherworld_descent.name: Netherworld Descent
netherworld_descent.description: Briefly overlays the battlefield with a predatory netherworld domain.

corpse_lantern_pale_flame_initiation_lan.name: Lantern Bind

Old Beggar Chen.title: The old beggar at the gate
Old Beggar Chen.board: whatever he happens to want done

Old Gou.title: Self-proclaimed hidden expert
Old Gou.board: the great works only he is qualified to delegate

commissions.title: The Replaced Crate
commissions.description: A consignment lot went missing between the Greenriver landings and the Pavilion cellar. The porters say river rocks; the manifest says otherwise. Find where the crate went. The name of the client stays with the Steward.

objectives.label: Ask Madam Pei Suyin what moved that night

commissions.title: A Quiet Valuation
commissions.description: A seller wants a lot appraised without the floor hearing of it. Walk the Pavilion, read the room rather than the ledger, and bring the Steward an honest word on who is bidding.

objectives.label: Read the room without being read

commissions.title: The Marsh Consignment
commissions.description: A lot promised to the Pavilion is still sitting in Moonfen Marsh and the handler has stopped answering. Go out, find out whether it is greed or something worse, and come back able to say which.

objectives.label: Get the truth out of the handler

commissions.title: Terms With the Furnace
commissions.description: The Pavilion wants a standing arrangement with Crimson Furnace Valley and would rather not send someone the Valley already dislikes. Carry the offer, keep your temper, and bring back an answer.

objectives.label: Put the offer to Furnace Examiner Huo Ren
Hold your ground when the terms are tested
Bring the answer back to Steward Qiao

commissions.title: Names on the Flood Register
commissions.description: Twelve villagers are down in the register as flood victims and the magistrate cannot make the count agree with the bodies. Walk the district, ask the people who were there, and tell him what you find.

objectives.label: Look at what the water left

commissions.title: The Foothill Dispute
commissions.description: Two cultivators are arguing over a Cloudspine claim and the magistrate has no authority over either of them. Go up, hear it out, and settle it before it becomes a district problem.

commissions.title: Where the Hollow Jade Goes
commissions.description: Black Tide has lost sight of a Hollow Jade route and Madam Pei does not intend to lose it twice. Walk it quietly, keep your face out of it, and bring her the shape of the thing.

commissions.title: An Informant in the Reeds
commissions.description: One of Madam Pei's people in Moonfen Marsh has gone quiet. She wants to know whether he is dead, bought, or simply careful — and she wants that answered by someone with no stake in the reply.

objectives.label: Ask the Lantern Keeper who still lights a lamp
Watch the reeds before you speak

commissions.title: The Ravine Ledger
commissions.description: A ledger Black Tide would pay a great deal for is somewhere in Black Serpent Ravine, in the hands of a handler who knows exactly what he has. Madam Pei does not care how. She cares that it is quiet.

objectives.label: Take the ledger without a witness
Deliver it to Madam Pei Suyin

commissions.title: A Bowl of Rice, and Nothing Else
commissions.description: The old beggar wants a bowl carried across Greenriver to a family he will not name, and he would like you to manage it without making a performance of your own generosity.
commissions.boast: Payment? Bring the bowl back empty and we will see what is in the bottom of it.

objectives.label: Hand it over without making a show of it
Notice what the family would not say

commissions.title: The Stone in the Road
commissions.description: There is a stone on the Cloudspine path that three cultivators have stepped over this month. The old man would like to know whether you are the fourth.
commissions.boast: There is nothing in it for you. Go anyway.

commissions.title: Recovery of the Nine-Yang Fragment (Authentic)
commissions.description: The great expert cannot retrieve it personally — his cultivation is at too delicate a stage — so he is prepared to let you have the honour, and the reward, which he describes at length.
commissions.boast: A share of an inheritance that emperors have died for. I do not insult a man by naming a figure.

objectives.label: Search the foothills where he says it fell

commissions.title: What the Rumour Was Worth
commissions.description: For once he is not selling anything. He heard something in Greenriver he cannot check himself, and he wants it checked by someone whose face is not known.
commissions.boast: A trifle. Beneath discussion. Go on.

objectives.label: See whether Madam Pei has heard it too
Keep your face out of it

commissions.title: The Gate Roster
commissions.description: Two names on the Azure Cloud duty roster have not stood their watch. Walk the gate, see who is missing, and be honest about it.

objectives.label: See who is not where the roster says
Report to Gate Elder Jian Mu

commissions.title: A Word With the Inquisitor
commissions.description: Inquisitor Shen Rui has been in Greenriver longer than a recruiting trip explains. The Gate would like to know what she is actually doing.

objectives.label: Get a straight answer without giving offence

commissions.title: Ash for the Second Furnace
commissions.description: The second furnace is running cold and the Examiner suspects the fuel rather than the formation. Go and find out which.

objectives.label: Read the furnace's flame with your own qi
Report to Furnace Examiner Huo Ren

commissions.title: The Apothecary's List
commissions.description: Apothecary Huo Lan sends a list to the Valley every season. This season's did not arrive, and the Examiner would rather not send a second letter.

objectives.label: Collect the list from Apothecary Huo Lan
Find out where the first letter went

commissions.title: The Terrace Watch
commissions.description: Something crosses the Terrace on the coldest nights and leaves no track. The Warden wants a disciple's eyes on it, not a report from the gate guards.

objectives.label: Report to Moon Warden Lin Yue

commissions.title: Bai Shuang's Errand
commissions.description: Disciple Bai Shuang went down to the Cloudspine Foothills on Palace business and has sent nothing back. Find her and settle whatever she has walked into.

objectives.label: Settle it without losing the Palace face

commissions.title: Feeding Day
commissions.description: The ravine pens are short a handler and the Clan does not postpone feeding day. Bring your own hands and do not be squeamish.

objectives.label: Work the pens through feeding day

commissions.title: The Marsh Handler's Debt
commissions.description: Handler She Fen owes the ravine a shipment and has been in Moonfen Marsh for a month. Collect, quietly.

commissions.title: Red Water, Clean Hands
commissions.description: Elder Xue Hong is recruiting in the Marsh and the Gorge wants to know whether she is recruiting for the Gorge. Ask her. Come back able to say.

objectives.label: Put the question to Elder Xue Hong
Hold your ground when she turns it back on you

commissions.title: What the Gorge Owes
commissions.description: A Greenriver broker holds a debt against the Gorge and has begun mentioning it in public. Make the mentioning stop. The debt itself is not your business.

objectives.label: Make the talking stop without making it worse

commissions.title: Names for the Register
commissions.description: The Marsh has produced more dead than the register has names. Lantern Keeper Mo has the tally; the Registrar wants it in a hand he can read.

objectives.label: Collect the tally from Lantern Keeper Mo
Reconcile it against what the Marsh will tell you

commissions.title: A Lantern Sold Twice
commissions.description: Something from the Pavilion's own stores is being offered at the Golden Pavilion by a broker who should not have it. Find out who sold it.

objectives.label: Trace it back without being traced
